source_release: TCIA version 1; IDC v24 metadata snapshot
selection_rule: Every SEG series in the pinned official IDC metadata projection whose PatientID already has TRAIN in the frozen cohort. No image, annotation content, quality or outcome filtering. All 79 existing TRAIN people have indexed SEG and remain in the denominator regardless of later QC.
scope_boundary: A separate annotation byte-intake extension. Preserve the completed raw MR/US intake and its original no-SEG scope without rewriting its receipts. This adds no patient and creates no independent evaluation cohort.

object_contract.source: Official IDC idc-open-data S3 HTTPS series-prefix listings, scoped only to the 242 TRAIN SEG series
object_contract.local_sha256: Computed only after byte transfer; not yet available
object_contract.each_entry: Pinned person/series/object identity, exact HTTPS URL, exact byte length and single-part ETag MD5 before payload GET. If-Match and response identity/length checks plus whole-file MD5 before atomic publish. Multipart ETags would not be treated as whole-file MD5.

label_availability.preoperative_label_timing: A Preop StudyDescription identifies a source imaging study, not proof that a retrospective annotation existed before the surgical decision. Actual reference frame, content, provenance and permissible availability require a separate intended-use review.
label_availability.intraoperative_and_residual_labels: Keep unavailable to preoperative actor inputs, decisions and rewards. Later separately declared research must respect measurement time and cannot imitate a residual/cavity as an optimal target.
label_availability.previous_resection_and_target_labels: Names alone do not establish time, annotation meaning, supervision eligibility or optimality. Preserve provenance and defer all use.
label_availability.same_patient_dependence: All annotations, referenced images, visits and derivatives inherit the existing person role. ReMIND2Reg aliases inherit the same role. No series-level split or added independent patient count.
label_availability.ancestry: Automatic/manual initialization and upstream generation ancestry are not fully audited for these exact SEG objects. Preserve unknown ancestry. Latest user steering permits synthetic/simulator-generated learning data; it does not confer label QC, timing validity or evaluation independence.
label_availability.diagnosis: The unchanged cohort has 63 strict-three-label candidate glioma TRAIN people and 16 outside that exact predicate. Diagnosis metadata remain unavailable to the preoperative actor; use of the generic component cohort does not admit all 79 to glioma-specific policy training.
label_availability.overlap: Unknown biological and pretrained exposure remain explicit. Preserve existing protected assignments on discovered aliases and resolve conflicts before intended-use admission.

intake.transport: Existing resumable verified-TLS acquire_public_case transport with unchanged acquire_btc_case source MD5 verifier and immutable intent/HTTP/result receipts; narrow SEG adapter only.
intake.release_requirement: Root freezes reviewed scope and hash-bound declaration before payload launch. No model-overlap exemption is implied. Announce actual worker identity at release/launch.
